title: Emergence of a New [NNN] Pincer Ligand via Si–H Bond Activation and β-Hydride Abstraction at Tetravalent Cerium

synthesis.procedure: Under inert argon/glovebox conditions, [Ce{N(SiMe3)2}3] (154.3 mg, 0.25 mmol), Li{N(SiMe3)2} (28.0 mg, 0.2 mmol), and Me2pzH (76.9 mg, 0.8 mmol) were stirred in THF for 16 h to generate in situ “Li[CeIII(Me2pz)4]”. The solution was dried in vacuo, the resulting powder was dissolved in toluene and stored at −35 °C, and 1,4-benzoquinone (13.0 mg, 0.12 mmol) was added at −35 °C, immediately giving a Bordeaux-colored solution. After stirring for 60 s the mixture was stored at −35 °C for 12 h, then filtered, concentrated in vacuo, and treated with n-hexane to give a colorless powder and Bordeaux-colored crystals identified by X-ray analysis as 8.

reagents.name: 1,4-benzoquinone
reagents.role: oxidant / source of pzhq ligand after pyrazolato attack

synthesis.temperature: THF stirring at ambient temperature; benzoquinone addition and crystallization at −35 °C
synthesis.time: 16 h in THF; 60 s stirring after benzoquinone addition; 12 h at −35 °C
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: dried in vacuo; residue dissolved in toluene; filtered after −35 °C storage; concentrated in vacuo; n-hexane layered/added to give Bordeaux-colored crystals of 8

properties.summary: No magnetic or optical measurements are reported for cluster 8; only crystal isolation (Bordeaux-colored crystals) and X-ray identification are described.
